# halos_fleet (Data Source)

Fleet size and per-ring host counts and drift (GET /api/v1/fleet). Per-host rows are deliberately not exposed, so no device or user data lands in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "halos_fleet" "this" {}

output "fleet_size" {
  value = data.halos_fleet.this.total
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `drift_hosts` (Number) Hosts not on their ring's release.
- `id` (String) Always `fleet`.
- `rings` (Attributes List) Per-ring statistics. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rings))
- `total` (Number) Enrolled hosts.

<a id="nestedatt--rings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rings`

Read-Only:

- `drift_hosts` (Number) Hosts in the ring that drifted.
- `hosts` (Number) Hosts in the ring.
- `percent` (Number) Share of the fleet, in percent.
- `ring` (String) Ring name.
